Bill.BriefDescription: Informing policyholders about insurer name changes.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to informing policyholders about insurer namechanges; and amending RCW 48.05.190.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 48.05.190 and 1947 c 79 s .05.19 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Every insurer shall conduct its business in its own legal name. (2) No insurer shall assume or use a name deceptively similar tothat of any other authorized insurer. (3) Every insurer that changes its name, whether it is a trade nameor legal name, shall send a written notification to all affectedpolicyholders about the name change. The notification must be sent bycertified mail or other means requiring proof of delivery.
